intervention: Official-source grounding for verifiable election-administration facts
selection_rationale: Directly addresses false voting guidance with an auditable authoritative-source rule
evidence_gap: Checked evidence concerns factual messages rather than deployed AI grounding or downstream voting behaviour
rank_eligibility_rationale: Requires common factual-accuracy and behavioural endpoints across alternative grounding designs
jurisdiction: National; Brazil provides a binding operational precedent

intervention: Adaptive jailbreak, fine-tuning and abliteration robustness testing
selection_rationale: Covers adversarial safeguard failure before deployment
evidence_gap: Legal scope and causal reduction in deployed manipulation remain unverified; threat completeness is unknown
rank_eligibility_rationale: Testing regimes are threat-model dependent and should be assessed against coverage gates

intervention: Pre-release safety case and Safety and Security Model Report
selection_rationale: Makes pre-release reasoning assumptions mitigations and residual risk inspectable
evidence_gap: Effect on release quality or harm is unestablished and the regulatory filing element remains proposed
rank_eligibility_rationale: A safety case is an assurance condition rather than a commensurable outcome intervention

intervention: Risk-tiered API identity and campaign-account verification
selection_rationale: Adds controller attribution at the high-volume access point
evidence_gap: No checked claims or direct evidence on deterrence bypass privacy error or displacement
rank_eligibility_rationale: Needs field implementation and a privacy-preserving attribution endpoint
jurisdiction: international recommendation; US IaaS proposal provides precedent

intervention: Release-modality safety case for open-weight models
selection_rationale: Covers irreversible and modifiable open-weight release rather than API deployment alone
evidence_gap: No direct evidence links a release assessment to reduced misuse and thresholds remain undefined
rank_eligibility_rationale: Needs prospective cases with predeclared capability reach reversibility and residual-risk criteria

intervention: Election-specific systemic-risk assessment and mitigation for very large platforms and search engines
selection_rationale: Provides an upstream product-level election-risk duty for dominant distribution systems
evidence_gap: Legal and mechanism claims are not fully checked and mitigation effectiveness lacks causal evidence
rank_eligibility_rationale: Platform risk-management packages are context-specific and multi-component

intervention: Vetted researcher access to non-public platform data
selection_rationale: Enables independent observation of exposure coordination and mitigation performance
evidence_gap: Scope and access practice need verification and access-to-enforcement or harm effects are unknown
rank_eligibility_rationale: Data access is enabling infrastructure and should be assessed for coverage timeliness and independence

intervention: Pre-election stress tests, readiness dialogues and regulator election toolkits
selection_rationale: Tests coordination and control gaps before time-critical incidents
evidence_gap: Operational claims are not fully checked and effects on response latency or electoral harm are indirect
rank_eligibility_rationale: Comparable exercises require shared scenarios injects readiness measures and follow-up verification
jurisdiction: EU and partner countries, including Moldova

intervention: Mandatory labels, sponsor notices and an EU repository for political advertising
selection_rationale: Creates inspectable sponsor targeting and spend records for paid influence
evidence_gap: Legal existence is checked but mechanism implementation and effects on voter recognition enforcement or evasion are not
rank_eligibility_rationale: Can later be compared with imprint and repository regimes using common coverage and use endpoints

intervention: Restrict personal-data political-ad targeting and prohibit special-category profiling
selection_rationale: Directly targets intimate-data political microtargeting and permits comparison with Brazil
evidence_gap: Legal status is checked but inference detection consent quality displacement and outcome effects remain open
rank_eligibility_rationale: Requires common targeting-scope enforcement and rights endpoints across jurisdictions

intervention: Machine-readable marking of AI-generated content and visible deepfake disclosure
selection_rationale: Links provider-side marking to human-visible disclosure in a binding framework
evidence_gap: Legal timing is checked but implementation coverage credential survival comprehension and behavioural effects are open
rank_eligibility_rationale: Needs comparable detection persistence comprehension and downstream-behaviour endpoints

intervention: Time-bound election Rapid Response System for platform escalation
selection_rationale: Adds a measurable final-hours escalation lane between trusted flaggers and platforms
evidence_gap: Status and operation need checking and there is no direct evidence on counterfactual response time or harm
rank_eligibility_rationale: Requires shared severity clocks resolution outcomes and false-escalation measures

intervention: Mandatory digital imprints on paid political material and specified organic campaign material
selection_rationale: Extends source attribution beyond paid ads and adds a UK statutory comparator
evidence_gap: Legal scope mechanism coverage voter use and enforcement effects remain unchecked
rank_eligibility_rationale: Can be compared with sponsor notices using attribution coverage and enforcement endpoints

intervention: Treat AI-cloned voices in robocalls as artificial voices requiring consent
selection_rationale: Adds a mature communications-law route for a documented synthetic-audio vector
evidence_gap: Legal scope and effectiveness are not claim-checked; compliance displacement and deterrence are unknown
rank_eligibility_rationale: Requires common consent identification complaint and evasion endpoints for synthetic-audio controls

intervention: End-to-end cryptographic provenance and interoperable Content Credentials
selection_rationale: Represents interoperable known-good provenance across creation editing and distribution
evidence_gap: Specification existence adoption persistence adversarial removal and human-use effects are not fully verified
rank_eligibility_rationale: Can compare technical provenance variants only after common coverage persistence and usability measures

intervention: Forwarding limits and forwarded-message friction in encrypted messaging
selection_rationale: Covers high-trust private-channel reach without requiring content inspection
evidence_gap: Checked evidence is observational and label-conditioned; causal reach behaviour and cross-context effects remain unresolved
rank_eligibility_rationale: Needs randomized or quasi-experimental forwarding reach and displacement endpoints

intervention: Technique-based prebunking and election media literacy
selection_rationale: Represents the only selected user-facing pre-exposure resilience control
evidence_gap: Immediate technique recognition is checked but persistence transfer sharing voting effects and field delivery remain uncertain
rank_eligibility_rationale: Requires common delayed recognition behaviour and election-context endpoints across interventions
jurisdiction: Global; adapted in EU election campaigns

intervention: Ban on electoral deepfakes used to favour or harm a candidacy
selection_rationale: Adds a binding prohibition comparator to disclosure and provenance controls
evidence_gap: Legal existence is checked but detection adjudication overbreadth evasion and outcome effects remain open
rank_eligibility_rationale: Requires matched election-window coverage enforcement rights and displacement measures

intervention: Ban on chatbots or avatars simulating conversation with a candidate or real person
selection_rationale: Directly addresses scalable false intimacy and candidate impersonation by interactive systems
evidence_gap: Legal existence is checked but scope disclosure compliance user recognition and causal effects are untested
rank_eligibility_rationale: Needs a comparator set for prohibition disclosure and verified-candidate interactive agents

intervention: Immediate de-amplification, evidence preservation and narrowly bounded corrective promotion
selection_rationale: Combines reach interruption evidence retention and targeted correction in one enforceable sequence
evidence_gap: Legal existence is checked but trigger accuracy response speed corrective effects and rights costs are unknown
rank_eligibility_rationale: Requires incident-matched reach latency correction and false-positive endpoints

intervention: CIEDDE-SIADE integrated election-disinformation alert and coordination system
selection_rationale: Adds an election-authority-led public reporting and response comparator outside the EU
evidence_gap: Operational scope throughput resolution quality and causal effect on incidents are not claim-checked
rank_eligibility_rationale: Can compare coordination systems after harmonizing severity latency action and appeal measures

intervention: Electoral data-protection duties for profiling and microtargeting
selection_rationale: Provides a campaign-specific Brazil comparator for data and vulnerability governance
evidence_gap: Legal existence is checked but enforcement coverage inferred-data treatment evasion and behavioural effects are open
rank_eligibility_rationale: Requires matched legal-basis profiling enforcement and rights endpoints with EU controls

intervention: Require a non-profiling recommender option
selection_rationale: Creates an observable user exit from profiling-based attention steering
evidence_gap: Legal existence is checked but discoverability adoption exposure diversity and agency effects remain untested
rank_eligibility_rationale: Needs interface take-up exposure and downstream agency endpoints across recommender options

intervention: Apply purpose limitation, minimization, access, correction, erasure and DPIAs to assistant memory
selection_rationale: Covers persistent intimate data as a future electoral-personalisation substrate
evidence_gap: Checked minimisation evidence is offline and non-electoral; legal scope deployment compliance and agency outcomes remain open
rank_eligibility_rationale: Requires assistant-specific minimisation privacy utility and manipulation-resistance endpoints

intervention: Provide complaints, investigation and remedial routes under the AI Act
selection_rationale: Completes the chain from detected harm to investigation remedy and public enforcement
evidence_gap: Scope is not fully checked and accessibility timeliness remedy quality and deterrent effects are unknown
rank_eligibility_rationale: Redress is a non-compensable institutional gate and not commensurable with preventive controls

intervention: Mandate independent annual audits of very large platforms
selection_rationale: Adds recurring independent assurance rather than one-off self-assessment
evidence_gap: Legal existence is checked but auditor independence audit depth correction closure and harm effects remain open
rank_eligibility_rationale: Audit is enabling governance and should be judged by independence scope and remediation closure

intervention: Evaluate, mitigate and report systemic risks from frontier general-purpose AI
selection_rationale: Connects frontier-model obligations to downstream systemic democratic risk
evidence_gap: Legal and mechanism claims are checked but control effectiveness remains an open question
rank_eligibility_rationale: Multi-component systemic-risk governance cannot be reduced to a universal ordinal effect score

intervention: Protect media pluralism and regulated media visibility on dominant platforms
selection_rationale: Retains a structural control on concentrated agenda-setting rather than only content-level measures
evidence_gap: Legal scope implementation effects viewpoint measurement and trade-offs need full verification
rank_eligibility_rationale: Pluralism is a rights and system condition requiring contextual indicators and gates

intervention: Require scoped authorization, action ledgers, reversibility and renewal for agentic actions
selection_rationale: Covers agentic execution and audit trails beyond content-generation controls
evidence_gap: No checked claims or direct field evidence; authorization semantics bypass burden and appeal remain unresolved
rank_eligibility_rationale: Needs prototype testing with harmful and benign workflows plus usability and bypass endpoints

intervention: Apply AI Act high-risk controls to systems intended to influence elections or voting behaviour
selection_rationale: Provides a direct lifecycle hook for AI systems intentionally built to influence elections
evidence_gap: Legal status is checked but application is phased and scope classification compliance and effectiveness are untested
rank_eligibility_rationale: High-risk lifecycle duties are a legal-control package rather than a single comparable treatment
